description: This file defines an enum 'ConnectionLifecycle' representing the lifecycle states of a connection, specifically 'ACTIVE' and 'DELETED'. It also provides a static method for retrieving an enum value based on a string input.

classes.name: ConnectionLifecycle
classes.description: An enumeration of a Connection's lifecycle states, providing 'ACTIVE' and 'DELETED', with a static method to retrieve a lifecycle by name.
